name: Volunteering at the Atlanta Community Food Bank (ages 8 and up with an adult)
what_you_do: Volunteers help at ongoing food bank projects. Youth under 18 come with an adult chaperone who stays the whole shift.
who_can_apply: Volunteers 8 and up at most ongoing projects. Anyone under 18 must come with an adult chaperone who stays the whole shift. Groups need 1 adult for every 4 youth ages 8 to 11 and 1 adult for every 8 youth ages 12 to 17. Adults register for shifts themselves.
deadline_text: Sign up for a shift on the volunteer calendar. Dates not on the calendar are full or not offered.
how_to_apply: An adult signs up for a shift on the volunteer calendar. Then email volunteers@acfb.org or call 404-419-1727 to add the youth to the registration. Groups of 8 or more fill out a group request form.
notes: Also open to younger kids. Wear closed-toe, closed-heel shoes. Stay for the whole shift. Come on time because late volunteers more than 30 minutes cannot serve. Special events may have other age rules.
